title: Scene 02: The Morning She Skipped

sections.title: After Rinku — home reset
paragraphs: Rinku ke jaate hi Ankita ne kitchen ka paani saaf kiya aur shower lekar office ke liye taiyaar ho gayi.

Kabir abhi bhi bedroom mein so raha tha. Karan aur Aman apne-apne rooms mein the. Rajeev Uncle bhi apne kamre se bahar nahi aaye the. Kitchen mein subah jo kuch hua tha, woh Ankita aur Rinku tak hi raha.

sections.title: Breakfast with Karan and Aman
paragraphs: Ankita laptop bag aur phone lekar dining table par pahunchi. Karan chai ke saath baitha tha. Aman phone par interview questions dekh raha tha.
Karan: “Good morning, Bhabhi! Aaj morning walk se jaldi wapas aa gayi?”
Ankita: “Walk par gayi hi nahi.”
Karan: “What? Mrs. Discipline ne chhutti le li?”
Ankita: “Tumhare bhai raat ko teen baje aaye. Neend khuli, phir subah filter ka kaam tha. Walk shaam ko shift kar di.”
Aman ne phone se nazar uthayi.
Aman: “Bhaiya abhi so rahe hain?”
Ankita: “Haan. Aur koi unhe disturb nahi karega.”
Karan ne muskurakar chai ka cup rakha.
Karan: “Achha, toh meri twenty push-ups wali challenge ka kya hua?”
Ankita: “Challenge cancel nahi hua, Mr. Show-off. Shaam ko society gym mein karenge.”
Karan: “Done! Aur haar gaya toh?”
Ankita: “Poora hafta mere saath morning workout. Kal jo decide hua tha, wohi rules hain.”
Aman: “Main witness rahunga.”
Karan: “Tu apne Java ke questions dekh, bhai!”
Ankita hans padi.
Ankita: “Aman, tum apne questions mujhe aaj bhej dena. Aur Karan, gym mein excuses nahi chalenge.”
Karan: “Aap bas time par aa jana.”
Ankita: “Office se lautne do pehle. Phir dekhte hain kiski stamina zyada hai.”
Usne breakfast finish kiya, bag uthaya aur ghadi dekhi.

sections.title: Rajeev in the hallway
paragraphs: Rajeev Uncle apne kamre se nikle. Haath mein newspaper tha.
Rajeev: “Office ja rahi ho, beta?”
Ankita: “Haan, Uncle. Aaj release follow-up hai.”
Rajeev: “Kabir so raha hai?”
Ankita: “Ji. Kaafi late aaya tha. Uthne par breakfast kar lega.”
Rajeev: “Theek hai. Dhyaan se jaana.”
Ankita: “Bye, Uncle.”
Baat wahi khatam ho gayi. Ankita ne lift ka button dabaya.

sections.title: Gopal at the society gate
paragraphs: Gopal register ke paas khada doosre security guard se baat kar raha tha.
Gopal: “Subah ka time sabse busy hota hai. Koi office, koi walk... sabka apna routine.”
Uski nazar Ankita par padi. Ek pal ke liye usne use kuch alag, jaise apne tak simti hui muskaan ke saath dekha।
Ankita ne bhi use dekha.
Kal shaam woh kitna chup ho gaya tha.
Ankita: “Good morning, Gopal ji.”
Gopal: “Good morning, madam. Aaj walk nahi hui?”
Ankita: “Nahi. Aaj schedule thoda change hai.”
Gopal: “Achha ji. Safe journey.”
Uski nazar phir ek pal Ankita par thahri, phir woh register ki taraf mud gaya.
Ankita ne koi aur sawaal nahi kiya.
Cab gate ke paas aa chuki thi.

sections.title: Cab departure
paragraphs: Ankita cab mein baithi aur apna work phone khola. Release dashboard par overnight checks complete dikh rahe the.
Uski calendar reminder mein pending equipment acknowledgment ka task bhi tha.
Rohit Babu.
Kal usne corrected inventory slip aaj laane ka promise kiya tha.

sections.title: Arriving at Cyber City
paragraphs: Office floor par aam working-day activity shuru ho chuki thi. Ankita ne ID scan kiya aur apni desk ki taraf badhi.
Door support counter par Rohit equipment registers check kar raha tha. Uske haath mein ek file thi.
Ankita ki nazar ek pal us par padi.
Kal Bhalla aur Sandeep ke saamne usne khud reactions test kiye the. Aaj subah Rinku ke saamne bhi usne apni taraf se initiative liya tha.
Rohit ka response kaisa hoga, woh abhi nahi jaanti thi.
Filhaal uske paas ek genuine office task tha—pending acknowledgment slip.
Ankita ne laptop bag desk par rakha.
Office ka din shuru ho chuka tha.
